title: Trade analysis: during and after each trade, trade plan, patterns
changes: New investments tab 'Trade analysis' built on daily bars (Twelve Data for stocks through /api/market?history=…, Coinbase for crypto); history kept in the browser (anav.history.v1) and loaded within the free plan's 8-per-minute limit, with the wait shown

Per trade: actual result after fees, holding days, highest high and lowest low while held (against the average entry), change 1 trading day, 1 week, 1 month and a chosen number of days after each sale
Partial exits: each sale measured on its own; summaries weighted by quantity sold and showing how many sales already have data
Hypothetical comparison with holding the sold quantity longer, labelled hypothetical with its assumptions (close price, no extra fees, dividends or tax)
Price chart with entries, exits, holding period, target and stop

Trade plan per trade: entry reason, strategy tags, target, stop, planned holding days, exit reason; adherence (exit at target / before target / at or below stop, holding vs plan) shown apart from hindsight results
Patterns with visible definitions and thresholds: went up then closed at a loss, kept rising after exit, dropped after exit, exited before target, closed below stop, no plan
Daily data only: the analysis says so and does not claim intraday precision; missing history is shown as missing
Tel Aviv history requires a higher Twelve Data plan; such symbols are marked 'no history'
